title: Tools held to their job; the deconvolution tool commissioned; IAM-A's grand test scored
set_out: Re-evaluate every limit against each tool's job, commission what already does its job, and score IAM-A's grand test.
open_at_turnover: Next: wire Atlas v2.1, the deconvolution tool and IAM-A's self-reference into the live run.
closing: IAM-A commissioned on its own reference, the deconvolution tool commissioned for shares, every tool held to its job, and chain v4 passing from a fresh public clone.
